source.title: Ulster Herald, 22 April 1933, p. 5 ("The rural boards: list of nominees")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the sixteen divisions, names and parties read from the Ulster Herald's 'List of nominees' (22 April 1933, p. 5); the Nationalist names checked against the Irish News of 19 April 1933

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Only one nomination was received for each of the sixteen divisions, so there was no contest and the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for 1 June 1933. Filed on 1933-05-31, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
